SurfaceScope.note: Two-item control with icons; the selected segment takes bg-selected + foreground ink, the unselected stays muted. Hairline border-input divider between segments renders.

ViewModes.note: Three icon+label segments at even height; first-child border suppression is visible at the left edge.

TextOnly.note: Label-only variant keeps the same 30px height and rounded-md clip; useful contrast against the icon cells.

WithDisabled.note: Disabled third segment renders at 50% with pointer events off while the group border stays continuous.

InAPageHeader.note: Control in its real habitat — right-aligned in a header row over a border-border hairline, which is how the product's scope headers use it.
